normal_gate_training_storage.checkpoint_persistence: indices only; ephemeral benign training features
normal_gate_training_storage.label_storage: constant Normal label or per-class attack key; no retained dense label array

replay_memory_storage.byte_scope: sample arrays only; excludes model weights, metadata, serialization overhead and transient training copies
replay_memory_storage.label_storage: constant Normal label or per-class attack key; no retained dense label array

allocation.stored_logits_policy: post-task at new-row admission; retained old row targets unchanged
allocation.stored_logits_scope: training memory rows only; float32 G[2], raw F[all_attack_classes], bool seen-at-admission target mask; no duplicate features

0.01.threshold_source: permanent Normal TRAIN holdout only; no test labels
0.01.ties: strict greater-than; no randomized tie breaking

0.02.threshold_source: permanent Normal TRAIN holdout only; no test labels
0.02.ties: strict greater-than; no randomized tie breaking

0.05.threshold_source: permanent Normal TRAIN holdout only; no test labels
0.05.ties: strict greater-than; no randomized tie breaking

calibration_pool_budget: outside M; permanent Normal TRAIN holdout; never optimized

calibration_pool_storage.byte_scope: sample arrays only; excludes model weights, metadata, serialization overhead and transient training copies
calibration_pool_storage.label_storage: constant Normal label or per-class attack key; no retained dense label array

derpp_adaptation: Task-boundary shared attack-memory DER++ adaptation: current and retained-old attack balanced CE, stored raw-logit MSE only over seen-at-admission outputs, independent old-memory replay CE. DUAL applies the latter two losses only to the stable contribution of the joint head; no plastic-branch distillation. Not online-reservoir DER++. No task-growing branches.
evaluation_scope: test forward forbidden in selection_only; calibration alpha is not guaranteed test FPR

family_metadata.head_policy: all eventual attack rows allocated at task zero; unseen rows masked from CE and inference

family_postprocess.cost_scope: post-task alignment only; no extra training

family_training_outputs: fixed full attack head from initialization; unseen classes masked in CE and inference

family_training_schedule.masked_mse_policy: only output columns seen when retained row entered memory; raw finite logits

gate_benign_teacher: previous-task G before any current-task updates; cached current benign logits

gate_training_schedule.kd_reduction: mean squared raw logits over eligible rows and both output columns

publication_derivation.changes: Only private absolute roots in command/path metadata are normalized; original identity and all original numeric values are unchanged.
publication_derivation.checkpoint_reference_base: checkpoint_file is unchanged and resolves against the original result directory, not this publication directory; weights are not exported.

selection_attack_holdout_storage.byte_scope: sample arrays only; excludes model weights, metadata, serialization overhead and transient training copies
selection_attack_holdout_storage.checkpoint_persistence: row IDs only; features read from bound TRAIN holdout for evaluation
selection_attack_holdout_storage.label_storage: constant Normal label or per-class attack key; no retained dense label array

selection_validation_policy: permanent Normal holdout plus lawful retained attack validation memory; evaluation only
validation_scope: permanent Normal TRAIN holdout plus current retained attack validation memory; never optimized
